decision_rule: Do not tune each input profile independently. Admit an input profile only if it improves or preserves behavior and self-identification gates under a frozen recipe, with all profile differences preserved in artifacts.
failure_criteria: profile adds slip ratio, slip angle, mu, tire-force labels, controller flags, feasibility labels, path tracking errors, TTC, or reference trajectory
profile comparison uses different training budgets, seeds, reward, curriculum, auxiliary losses, or evaluation corpus
v_parallel_i is promoted to the main actor contract without outperforming driver-like minimal and raw-wheel profiles under the same recipe
hypothesis: A cleaner driver-like minimal profile can test professional-driver-like self-identification more directly than profiles that feed low-level tire diagnostics; raw wheel speed and v_parallel_i should be optional evidence branches, not assumed inputs.
success_criteria: profiles are documented with exact actor-visible fields and normalized dimensions
no profile uses hidden simulator parameters, tire diagnostics, planner answers, or controller flags as actor input
supervised probe artifacts keep seeds, history windows, targets, and evaluator fixed across profiles
RL comparison, if run, uses one frozen recipe across all compared profiles
